zh-Hant.name: 射氣球
zh-Hant.summary: 氣球從攤位後面往上飄，點一下射破加分，白鴿、天燈和炸彈氣球可別射。可選四段難度，也能挑戰電腦對手。
zh-Hant.controls: 點氣球射擊（鍵盤：方向鍵移動準星、空白鍵發射）

zh-Hans.name: 射气球
zh-Hans.summary: 气球从摊位后面往上飘，点一下射破加分，白鸽、天灯和炸弹气球可别射。可选四段难度，也能挑战电脑对手。
zh-Hans.controls: 点气球射击（键盘：方向键移动准星、空白键发射）

en.name: Balloon Shooter
en.summary: Balloons float up from behind the stall. Tap to pop them for points, but do not shoot the doves, sky lanterns, or bomb balloons. Choose from four difficulty levels and play solo or against computer opponents.
en.controls: Tap a balloon to shoot (keyboard: arrow keys to move the crosshair, space bar to fire)
